messages:
jordan: Quick heads-up from today's quant-onboard canary: nova-lite-int8 sometimes generates a partial funcall then the stream cuts. Runtime retries => duplicate side-effects in staging.

maria: example?

jordan: short trace:
```
chunk1: '{"action": "call", "name": "create_db_entry"'
chunk2: ', "args": {"key": "x"}}'
chunk3: <lost EOS>
parser: EOFError -> runtime retry -> duplicated DB insert
```

ashley: two-pronged fix: 1) small quiesce (derived from chunk_gap p95) before retry on EOF, 2) parser emits partial_funccall flag; if set, suppress auto-retry and return structured error for orchestration to handle.

eval-bot: test plan: synthetic tail-drop injected at 0.6% across 10k streaming requests. Compare baseline, quiesce-150ms, quiesce-300ms, and flag-only. Metrics: dup_invokes_per_100k, parse_fail_rate, added_latency_p95.

infra-bot: telemetry: chunk_gap_ms p50=19 p95=130 p99=280.

maria: owners? I'll draft RFC. Ashley take parser flag, Jordan take runtime quiesce + RequestState plumbing.

jordan: will PR runtime patch today and run canary tomorrow.

maria: acceptance: combined approach reduces duplicates by >=90% with parse-fail regression <0.05%.
